Links you can follow and diagrams you can zoom into.

## New

- **Click links in the preview to follow them.**
  - Links to headings (`#getting-started`) scroll to them.
  - Links to other Markdown files open them in Downmark, at the heading they name. They open in a new tab, or in place of the current document if you choose that in **Settings → Links**. Ctrl-click (Command-click on macOS) or middle-click does the other.
  - Web links show where they lead and open in your browser once you agree. You can turn the prompt off.
  - Links to other files open in their own apps after you confirm.
- **Open a Mermaid diagram in its own window** by clicking it. The window fits the diagram, and you can zoom with the wheel, a pinch, double-click or the `+`/`-` keys, then drag to move around. Zoomed in, the diagram is redrawn at that size, so small labels stay crisp. Press `0` to fit it again and Esc to close.

## Downloads

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 11+ (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Downmark-0.1.1-macos-universal.dmg`: open it and drag Downmark to Applications |
| Windows 10+ | `Downmark-0.1.1-windows-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `Downmark-0.1.1-windows-x64.zip` (portable) |
| Linux x86_64 | `Downmark-0.1.1-x86_64.AppImage` (`chmod +x` it, then run it) or `downmark-0.1.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

The macOS app is signed and notarized. The Windows files aren't signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time: choose **More info → Run anyway**. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.
